column5: ROUTE + DETAIL PAGE NOW BUILT (2026-08-05). /play/hilo exists in src/App.tsx and mounts HiLoGame with variant="fullscreen" inside GameShell - the SAME widget the casino grid opens, so the page cannot settle a card differently from the modal - with HiLoPageSections rendering the whole 1440x3294 column beneath it: stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer. Copy in hiloPageContent.ts, cited node by node. The 768 (9058-4372) and 375 (9351-4708) tiers are served by the same page's breakpoints, the sibling /play/* pattern, not by second implementations. hilo added to ROUTED_GAME_PATHS in Play.tsx, PlayOriginals.tsx and GameDetailPage.tsx. HiLoGame gained variant + onSeedChange and its three Dialog wrappers (main, disabled-notice, faucet) became GameShell - shell only, zero lines of card or settlement logic touched. The strip's verifier is fed from roundProof (the four fields the SETTLEMENT response returns together), never the legacy secure-session store, whose hash/clientSeed/bet-COUNT belong to no real round and would report a false 'server seed hash does not match' on an honest round. * CATALOG RE-CUT, EVERY FRAME RENDERED AND READ. This section is mis-filed in BOTH directions and the previous verdict had two of them backwards. NOT HI-LO (Scratchers filed under Hi-Lo): 9058-1833 "Desktop" is a 3x3 match-3 symbol grid under a "Match 3 to Win!" header with a six-symbol 1.98x paytable; 9058-7261 is that same paytable row; 9058-2367 "Card out" is a generic Manual/Auto bet panel with no higher/lower control at all; 9058-5154 (768x1607) is genuinely Scratchers AND correctly titled - match-3 board, Manual/Auto, Bet/Target. NOT SKAI AT ALL, must never be built: 9332-27318 and 9332-27319 are phone photos of stake.us (Stake wordmark, Login/Register, "Stake Originals", "stake.us - Private" in the browser bar) - a COMPETITOR's Hi-Lo. Their paytable (Same 7.69% / Lower 92.31%, Net Gain 12.87x / 1.07x) is Stake's and was copied nowhere. HI-LO BUT MIS-TITLED - correcting the earlier verdict: 9058-4372 (768x1627) is titled "Skai > Play > Casino > Scratchers" in its layer name AND in its own rendered breadcrumb, but it is the HI-LO TABLET page (3-of-hearts card, King/Ace ghost cards, Profit Higher (1.17x) / Profit Lower (4.29x), drawn-cards strip, Bet panel); and 9351-4708 is titled "Blackjack (375 x 812px)" but is the Hi-Lo 375 page at 375x1605. CORRECTLY FILED HI-LO: 9061-10499 (desktop start), 9061-9472 (desktop loss), 9332-27320 (mobile board), 9351-3397 (hero illustration) and 9079-3253 (an image node named "Screenshot 2026-07-23..." whose content is a SKAI Hi-Lo board - same King/Ace ghosts, same Profit Higher/Lower fields - so a reference capture, not a competitor photo). NEITHER: 9058-6701 "Layout" is the SHARED stats/fairness strip every game detail page draws. Real Hi-Lo surface = 7 frames (2 desktop, 1 tablet, 2 mobile, 1 hero, 1 capture), not 12. * FRAME NUMBER BUGS, REPORTED NOT BUILT: for identical stated odds (Higher-or-Same 30.77%, Lower-or-Same 76.92%) the Start frame prints Higher 1.17x / Lower 4.29x while the Loss frame prints 3.22x / 1.29x. Only Loss is arithmetically consistent (0.99/0.3077 = 3.22); Start is INVERTED and would be house-negative if built as drawn. The tablet frame 9058-4372 repeats Start's inverted pair, and the mobile board 9332-27320 is worse again - ONE probability (53.58%) against BOTH arrows while still showing 1.17x / 4.29x. None of those numbers were copied: the page renders no odds or profit figures, and the widget computes its own from the live config. * FRAME NUMBERS NOT REPRODUCED (no-mock rule): the Community-wins sample rows (@CryptoQueen88, $8,481.10, 2.67x, every row labelled "Blackjack"), the "N playing" counts and "Total: $89.01" - the desktop frame's Community-wins figure, which no rail produces. The page renders the live useRecentBets / liveGamingService feeds and the design's honest empty states instead, and ships the 375 frame's "All time" range pill where desktop draws the fabricated total. Also dropped: "Try Crash in Fun Mode" (wrong game AND a mode no Skai title has) and the two Figma authoring defects ("verified using verified", "exlusive"). * STILL OPEN, unchanged by this pass and owned by whoever holds the widget internals: HiLoGame implements none of the frame's Skip Card control, the King/Ace ghost cards flanking the live card, the split Profit(High)/Profit(Low) fields or the drawn-cards strip, and it adds a 7777 JACKPOT toggle (JACKPOT_NUMBER) that appears in no frame. * ECONOMICS unchanged and consistent: admin key hilo_house_edge is a FRACTION (default 0.01), the client reads it as one, and the live POINTS rail points-game:5313 is also 99/wc - they AGREE at 1%, no player-visible discrepancy. The dormant money rail game-settlement:3957 uses 95/wc, so enabling REAL_MONEY_PLAY_ENABLED would cut Hi-Lo payouts 4.21%. Hi-Lo running 1% while Dice/Mines/Chicken/Crash run higher is a product decision, not a bug. Page verified by typecheck + build; frames not yet visually diffed. ★★★ 2026-08-05 - THE DESIGN DRAWS A CARD GAME; THE RAIL DEALS A DICE ROLL. THE PAGE COPY NOW FOLLOWS THE RAIL. Route loaded and rendered at /play/hilo: page mounts, no mount errors, widget reaches the settlement rail (BET HI -> "Sign in and connect a wallet", i.e. blocked only by the local dev session having no wallet). What that render exposed is bigger than a frame gap: the WIDGET IS NOT A CARD GAME. HiLoGame.tsx - the one and only Hi-Lo component, the same one the casino grid opens - is a SINGLE 0-9999 ROLL with a win-chance slider: drag Win Chance (10-94.5%), which sets a threshold; HI wins above it, LO below; multiplier = (100/wc)*(1-0.01), quoted before the bet; ONE roll settles it. No deck, no streak, no rung ladder, no cash-out. The rail agrees on both paths - points-game play_hilo (index.ts:5459-5493) rolls `roll % 10000` against a side-specific threshold, game-settlement playHiLo (:3941) does the same. Neither draws a card. The previously-shipped game-info blurb was Figma 9061:10760 verbatim - "guess whether the next CARD lands higher or lower", "ride the STREAK", "each correct call STACKS your multiplier", "CASH OUT on a hot run" - four clauses naming four mechanics the game does not have. That is a game-info card promising a player rules the game will not honour, so it was rewritten from the rail; the frame's wording is quoted IN FULL in the JSDoc on `description` so the designer can reconcile the two deliberately. Same fix on three more strings that named a deck the game has no concept of: HILO_SUBBAR.refresh "Start a fresh card" -> "Start a fresh round" (the button calls onReset, which clears the roll history), seedPending "Play a card to reveal..." -> "Place a bet to reveal...", and the funds FAQ "the card that came out can be re-derived" -> "the roll that came out". The earlier STILL-OPEN list above reads as though the widget were an INCOMPLETE card game missing a Skip Card control, King/Ace ghost cards and a drawn-cards strip; it is not incomplete, it is a DIFFERENT GAME, and whether Hi-Lo should become the card game the frames draw is a product call plus a rail change, not something this page settles by what it prints in the meantime. NOT silently reconciled the other way: the rail was not touched. ECONOMICS RE-VERIFIED this pass and the claim above holds - client HiLoGame.tsx:410 `HILO_RAIL_EDGE = 0.01` and points-game:5474 `multiplier = 99/wc` agree exactly at 1%, and the live panel quotes 1.98x at a 50% win chance = 99/50. Confirmed correct, not assumed. ★★★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE RE-VERIFIED IN A BROWSER AND TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED - the earlier 'route loaded, nothing needed fixing' verdict was measured at desktop only. (1) THE BOARD RENDERED TWICE BELOW 1024px. HiLoGame's centre column carried `col-span-6 flex flex-col` and nothing else. `col-span-*` is a GRID property and the parent is `flex flex-col lg:grid`, so below lg the class was inert and the DESKTOP column painted anyway - on top of the `lg:hidden` mobile block above it, which already draws its own roll display and its own BET LO / BET HI pair. Measured on the live route at 390px: FOUR bet buttons (two full pairs at y=347 and y=1256) and TWO 'Roll Result' panels. A phone player saw the board twice with two live pairs of bet CTAs. Fixed to `hidden col-span-6 lg:flex flex-col` and re-measured: at 390px exactly one visible pair (y=347, w=137) with the desktop column collapsed to 0x0, and at 1440px the mobile block collapses to 0x0 while the desktop pair renders unchanged at x=427/755 w=316. Pure presentation - the same widget the casino grid opens, so the modal is fixed too. (2) THE '7777 JACKPOT / 777x' TOGGLE ADVERTISED A PRIZE NO RAIL PAYS, AND IT IS NOW NOT RENDERED. It was wrong against BOTH rails at once. POINTS, the rail the casino settles on: points-game's play_hilo (index.ts:5459-5493) has no jackpot code at all - it returns result/payout/multiplier and never jackpotWon - and playPointsHiLo (src/services/gaming/pointsGameService.ts:385-412) does not even forward jackpotEnabled, so the badge offered 777x at probability ZERO while charging a 0.1% fee that only ever moved the client-side balance check. SKAI/sUSD, dormant: game-settlement's playHiLo DOES implement the 7777 side bet - at HILO_JACKPOT_PRIZE_MULTIPLIER = 9.5 (index.ts:3939), whose own comment records that 777 was removed as 'a free +7.77% RTP exploit pushing hilo >100%'. So the badge quoted 81.8x more than the only rail that implements the feature would pay. NOT reconciled the cheap way: neither rail was touched (restoring 777 IS the documented exploit) and the client constant was not raised to meet it. No hilo frame draws a jackpot control at all, so the toggle was a client-side invention and the honest render is no control - the toggle, the 'J' hotkey, its shortcut-sheet row and the JACKPOT_NUMBER / JACKPOT_PRIZE_MULTIPLIER constants are gone (removing two baseline typecheck errors with them); jackpotEnabled stays pinned false so jackpotFee is 0 and the settlement call is byte-identical to a plain bet. Confirmed absent from the rendered page. (3) A `false &&` DEBUG HACK disabling the no-balance faucet notice was found uncommitted in HiLoGame.tsx (14h stale) and reverted; the notice now renders correctly for a zero-balance session, which is what a deploy-from-working-tree would otherwise have shipped broken.
